I am a 46-year-old woman farmer in SNNP with 0.22 hectares of enset on this plot. I do not use chemical fertilizer here because the cooperative mainly distributes DAP and urea for maize and teff, and my enset grows well enough with the cow manure and compost I spread each year. I will tend this plot with my family—weeding, mulching, and harvesting the kocho and amicho as the season progresses—but I cannot afford to hire outside labor for such a small piece of land when we have our own hands.
